channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: UN nuclear chief says Iran inspections will happen, Tehran says after deal
item.description: Head of the IAEA, Rafael Grossi, said the MoU stated 'explicitly' that the agency would supervise inspections in Iran.

item.title: Palestinian boy amongst dead in Israeli strike on displaced tent in Gaza
item.description: An Israeli drone strike on a tent sheltering displaced Palestinians in Khan Younis killed two people, including a child.

item.title: Iran’s president awarded honorary doctorate in Pakistan
item.description: Iran’s President Masoud Pezeshkian was awarded an honorary medical fellowship in cardiac surgery.

item.title: Has the worst of the Hormuz crisis passed?
item.description: Ships are moving again through the Strait of Hormuz, with oil prices falling. But relief for consumers may take longer.

item.title: Israeli attacks on Gaza and occupied West Bank kill two, including child
item.description: Health officials at Nasser Medical Complex tell Al Jazeera a 12-year-old child was killed in al-Mawasi, Gaza.

item.title: Rubio says Iran cannot charge tolls in Hormuz: What we know
item.description: Tehran says the strait 'will never return' to its prewar conditions and claims it can charge fees for services.

item.title: Rubio tries to reassure Gulf allies on US-Iran deal details
item.description: Rubio tours Gulf in bid to allay allies' security concerns over the US-Iran memorandum of understanding.

item.title: UN nuclear chief says inspectors will visit Iran sites as part of war deal
item.description: Rafael Grossi says the IAEA is "working on modalities" but an Iranian minister says such access would only be part of a final deal with the US.

item.title: Clean sweep for Mamdani-backed candidates in New York's Democratic primary
item.description: Brad Lander unseats Dan Goldman in a race that laid bare the city's divisions over the Israel-Gaza war.

item.title: Bondi Beach shooting hero pleads not guilty to alleged assault on his father
item.description: Ahmed al Ahmed tackled one of the gunmen who killed 15 people at a Jewish event in December.
